During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], sometime before [[3964 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] '''attacked''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quelii]] and inflicted heavy casualties on the civilian population. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] known as [[Darth Malak|Alek Squinquargesimus]], who was born on Quelii, managed to escape the battle, and eventually became a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]].

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This battle was first mentioned in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 42|forty–second issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Knights of the Old Republic'' comic series]], written by [[John Jackson Miller]]. It was created as part of the backstory for the Jedi Malak, formerly known as Alek Squinquargesimus.<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook]]''</ref> When asked by a user on the [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse]] message boards, Miller confirmed that the battle was [[canon]].<ref>{{DHBoards|url=viewtopic.php?t=16225|thread=Question for John Jackson Miller|user=Jedi Kasra|date=2009-09-30|time=13:13}}</ref>
